The text contains non-inclusive language by using the phrase "the blind," which is considered person-first or identity-first language that can be seen as defining individuals solely by their disability. It is more inclusive to use "people who are blind" or "visually impaired individuals." Additionally, the text lacks specific accessibility features such as alt text for images (if any were present) or clear headings, though as a short paragraph, its primary issue is linguistic.

The color of a common crow is black.
